datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0S THRU BZT52C75S SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES (SOD-323 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: BZT52C13S table row gives VZ min/nom/max = 12.4/13.0/14.1 V at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT = 30 ohm at IZT; ZZK = 170 ohm at IZK = 1.0 mA; IR = 0.1 uA at VR = 8.0 V (p. 2).
Fig.2 11 V to 43 V zener characteristics contains the 13 V family trace; points were digitized from the printed linear-voltage/linear-current grid and plotted mA values were converted to SI amperes.
No per-part capacitance or reverse-recovery time is published. The 200 mW power-dissipation rating and IZM are limits, not fitted breakdown data.
